subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ACME Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sonal Shah <sonal.shah@acmehealth.com>, Luke Turner <l.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals - ACME Health

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful conversation. Below is a short recap to make sure we’re aligned on pain, success criteria, and next steps for observability and evals for your LLM pipelines.

Pain points discussed:
- Silent regressions: model quality shifts that only show up in production metrics weeks later.
- Lack of prompt-level visibility: hard to trace which prompts or prompt variants caused quality drops.
- Limited dashboards: current Datadog setup only surfaces infrastructure telemetry, not prompt/eval signals.
- Risky rollouts: no automatic guardrails for canaries or quick rollback tied to quality regressions.

Current stack & constraints:
- In-house orchestration running open LLMs on GCP (K8s + Vertex AI for model runtime).
- Datadog for infra tracing; no standardized prompt tracing or golden prompt monitoring yet.
- Security: PII-sensitive workloads; non-prod access must be in your dev/test VPC (no public endpoints).

Success criteria for POC (what ACME said success looks like):
1) Detect regressions within 24 hours of deployment with alerting tied to a small golden prompt set.
2) Per-prompt observability: show latency, token cost, and quality metrics (automated eval score) per prompt variant.
3) Rollout guardrails: automatic canary monitoring and automatic rollback trigger if regression thresholds hit.
4) Minimal friction to integrate tracing hooks into existing request path and non-prod evaluation environment in 2–3 weeks.

What Redwood can provide (initial proposal):
- Dashboards: template dashboards for prompt-level metrics, regression trends, and cost/latency breakdowns.
- Tracing hooks: lightweight SDK snippets to capture prompt metadata, model version, and evaluation keys to link traces to samples.
- Golden prompt sets & eval harness: help curate a 100–200 sample golden set and run nightly evals with regression alerts.
- Rollout guardrails: canary policies, automatic fallback to a baseline model, and integration with your CI/CD.

Requested artifacts from ACME to accelerate POC:
- Representative golden prompt CSV (100–200 rows) and a small sample of production requests (anonymized).
- A non-prod endpoint/access in your test VPC we can use for the eval harness.
- Any existing Datadog dashboards or query examples you want mirrored.

Next steps (agreed on call):
- ACME: share golden prompt CSV and sample anonymized requests by end of day Friday (Sonal).
- Redwood: provide a POC plan + timeline and a draft dashboard by next Wednesday (Mar 25).
- Schedule technical deep-dive: Vivek will do the integration details with your infra team (proposed Wed, Mar 24).

Attachments: redwood_observability-deck.pdf (POC deck), acme_requirements_template.xlsx (artifact checklist).

If I missed anything or the priorities should shift, call it out — otherwise I’ll send the POC plan and timeline tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks — I can take point on the tracing hooks and the POC infra. Quick tech notes / asks from our side:
- Tracing approach: we'll provide a lightweight SDK (Python + Node) that attaches a trace-id and the following metadata to each request: prompt_id, prompt_variant, model_version, customer_request_id. That will let us link traces to eval results.
- Non-prod access: static IP whitelist is easiest for initial POC. If ACME prefers mTLS we can support cert-based auth too — we’ll need cert provisioning details.
- Data we need from ACME to run evals: anonymized sample requests (1k rows), the golden prompt CSV, and expected label/score function (if you have one).
- Timeline: Vivek + infra can be ready to run first nightly eval 7 days after we get the artifacts and VPC access (est. Mar 27 if we get assets Friday).

I’ll schedule the deep-dive for Wed Mar 24 (30–45m) to walk the infra and SDK integration — calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-technical-dive.

Ethan — once you have the dashboards, share as a Drive link and I’ll wire them into our POC monitoring.

- Vivek
